notes.title: Release 1.3.0 (2023-02-12)
Work in progress for a new release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I working for the v1.3.0 release this month and it will be released between the end of December and January.
The v1.3.0 will be a very important version because it will contains a full review of the english translation in order to fix some typos and improve the overall quality.
Furthermore, it will contains also the fixes of minor bugs.
Thanks for your useful feedback and stay tuned!
